finding: The authorized IDEA225/SRC texts attest abuse, the devil as agent, use since the beginning, and an unchanged style. They do not explicitly affirm or entail that the strategy is still being run because it still works wherever it is not resisted by truth. Lexical absence of the clause is not the reason; the causal relation itself is missing.
